hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Process queries by marking specified indices and k smallest unmarked elements.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A min heap tracking (nums[i], i) allows fast extraction of smallest unmarked elements.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Keep a boolean marked array and track total unmarked sum. Deduct from total whenever a newly marked element is processed.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def unmarkedSumArray(self, nums: list[int], queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        import heapq
        n = len(nums)
        marked = [False] * n
        total = sum(nums)
        heap = [(nums[i], i) for i in range(n)]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        ans = []
        for idx, k in queries:
            if not marked[idx]:
                marked[idx] = True
                total -= nums[idx]
            while k > 0 and heap:
                val, i = heapq.heappop(heap)
                if not marked[i]:
                    marked[i] = True
                    total -= val
                    k -= 1
            ans.append(total)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Min heap with lazy invalidation of marked elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning for the minimum element on each query takes O(q * k * n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain running sum and extract smallest unmarked elements via priority queue.
